title: Maternity & Delivery Package Pre-Delivery Balance: Computation Sheet
content:
**Scope.** For the pre-delivery balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery estimate under Good Faith & Price Estimates this sheet settles the amount, and only for such a balance. The pre-service balance on an outpatient surgery package is not figured by it, and on every other package type with balance-due days above zero the rest of the package price is paid no later than that many calendar days before the scheduled service date as a pre-service balance deposit.

**No pre-delivery balance owed.** A maternity booking whose patient's award covers the expected delivery date and either is at the Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) tier, or carries a hardship liability cap with no cap left, and a maternity booking whose balance figure comes to zero or less, owe no pre-delivery balance and are outside this sheet. The patient's award is the patient's approved case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the expected delivery date when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

**The balance.** The pre-delivery balance on a maternity and delivery package is the rest of the delivery package price: the delivery package price less the deposits held on the maternity estimate, rounded half-up to the cent. The delivery package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line that carry the principal service code on the current version, and the deposits held on the maternity estimate are its deposit collections less every refund, retained fee and application drawn on them.

**Figuring it.** A figure that takes the place of the delivery package price does so before the deposits held are taken off; every amount added to or taken off the balance is figured on its own and added to or taken from that rest; and the total is rounded half-up to the cent once at the end (an exact half cent going up).

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Riverbend facility line, principal code | 8000.00 |
| Riverbend professional line, principal code | 2000.00 |
| Delivery package price | 10000.00 |
| Deposit collections | 2500.00 |
| Refunds, retained fees and applications drawn on them | 0.00 |
| Deposits held | 2500.00 |
| Pre-delivery balance (10000.00 less 2500.00) | 7500.00 |

With deposits held of 10000.00 or more the figure is zero or less, and no pre-delivery balance is owed.
